issue_request: FHIR-27746 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for R5 asking to replace the deprecated Google Sheet link at the end of versions.html#maturity with the current non-deprecated spreadsheet.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-27746 was found. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-08-31 recorded the technical correction, but the traceable source application occurred later through FHIR-33957.
additional_context: FHIR-33957 later addressed the same unavailable maturity-analysis Google Sheet by approving an HL7 permalink, and commit 8870cd83bf546e0bec302c4f277756cc0838ad2e changed source/versions.html to that permalink. The already-published FHIR-45946 reconciliation on the combined branch then refined the same paragraph to link directly to the Confluence Maturity Model Analysis page.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source/versions.html line now links to https://confluence.hl7.org/display/FHIR/Maturity+Model+Analysis and no longer contains the deprecated Google Sheet URL.
